datasets.title: State of Palestine Roads (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 48.5 thousand km of roads in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 78 % of the total road length in the dataset region. The average age of data for the region is 2 years ( Last edited 4 months ago ) and 10% of roads were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['highway'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en highway surface smoothness width lanes oneway bridge layer source name:ar This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_pse_roads]
datasets.details: OpenStreetMap data is crowd sourced and cannot be considered to be exhaustive

lineage.description: Road network data extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information database for State of Palestine. Data includes 48.5 thousand km of road features with attributes such as highway classification, surface type, width, lanes, and bridge indicators. Dataset represents current state of OSM coverage with average data age of 2 years and 10% of roads updated within the last 6 months.
